تختصرين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَصِرِينَ (taḵtaṣirīna) /tax.ta.sˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# تُخْتَصَرِينَ (tuḵtaṣarīna) /tux.ta.sˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
